programs.title: Freddy
programs.desc: Freddy, a lonely dentist, meets Kainaaz, who has an abusive husband, and their romance is further complicated by Freddy's obsessive behavior, as he is willing to do whatever it takes to be with her. Kartik Aaryan, Alaya F, Karan Pandit, Sajjad Delafrooz, Myrna S. Dalal, Shashanka Ghosh, Parveez Sheikh, Aseem Arrora.

programs.title: Finding Fanny
programs.desc: A man embarks on a road trip to find his lost love. Deepika Padukone, Arjun Kapoor, Naseeruddin Shah, Dimple Kapadia, Anjali Patil, Homi Adajania, Homi Adajania, Kersi Khambatta.

programs.title: Love By Force
programs.desc: Naitik and Akshara are forced to marry, while love brings Kartik and Naira together, revealing the difference between love-based relationships and forced marriage. Hina Khan, Karan Mehra.

programs.title: Mannat
programs.desc: Drama Mannat, a gifted chef, works under a boss who is unknowingly her biological mother, and as her dreams for the future collide with the hidden truths of her past, fate begins to reorder her life. Mukta Dhond.

programs.title: The Bitter Harvest
programs.desc: Zeba is forced to question everything when the man she depends on begins to change in unexpected ways. Caught between family pressure and emotional detachment, she struggles to hold her life together. Sanam Saeed, Emmad Irfani.

programs.title: Jhanak
programs.desc: Determined to fulfill her mother's dream of a better life, a young woman faces numerous trials and personal loss, only to have her journey further complicated by a man she meets along the way. Hiba Nawab, Krushal Ahuja.
